question: Should OpenClaw adopt this combined Teams authorization and Workspaces distribution stack, including the new public `api.teams` plugin SDK contract, as the supported product direction?
rationale: This is not a narrow distribution patch; it establishes identity, authorization, persisted-state, gateway, plugin SDK, and member-portal contracts whose scope and permanence require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full stack
options.body: Approve the Teams and Workspaces architecture, API direction, and ordered landing plan, then require compatibility and live-proof gates on a rebased head.

options.title: Split distribution from Teams
options.body: Keep owner-only local export and import in a focused PR while the Teams and public authorization APIs receive separate design review.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Hold or close the branch until maintainers choose a smaller Workspaces distribution and multi-user sharing architecture.

recommendation.title: Split distribution from Teams
recommendation.body: Keep owner-only local export and import in a focused PR while the Teams and public authorization APIs receive separate design review.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed person connected to the full feature history in the supplied context; an official decision owner could not be established.
